india.one_line: India sees AI growth with new funding, infrastructure, policy framework, and corporate partnerships.

themes.title: Karta AI secures seed funding
themes.text: Karta AI raised $3 million in a seed round led by PeerCapital and Cedar Hill Capital to automate complex inbound banking calls across 25 languages.

stories.headline: Karta AI raises $3 million seed round to automate complex inbound banking calls

themes.title: Vultr opens AI supercluster in Chennai
themes.text: Vultr launched a 20 MW AI supercluster in Chennai equipped with AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs, the largest such installation in India.

stories.headline: Vultr launches 20 MW AI supercluster in Chennai with AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs

themes.title: India drafts AI defence trust framework
themes.text: The Indian government developed a domestic framework to evaluate AI trustworthiness in defence, focusing on reliability, safety and transparency, and co‑sponsored a UN informal exchange on military AI.

stories.headline: India creates domestic framework to evaluate AI trustworthiness in defence

themes.title: Tech Mahindra teams with SpaceXSI
themes.text: Tech Mahindra partnered with AI coding platform SpaceXSI to offer AI‑assisted software engineering services for modernising legacy applications and boosting developer productivity.

stories.headline: Tech Mahindra partners with SpaceXSI to boost AI‑assisted software engineering
